newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds-Prices steady, outlook unclear.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds-Prices steady, outlook unclear.

text.p: Millfeed prices were mostly steady on Wednesday as sellers attempted to take a stand after the recent slide in prices, dealers said.
Views were mixed on whether the market may have reached a bottom or the downtrend would resume shortly.
"Sellers have stopped quoting lower, but there just isn't any feed demand right now," one Kansas dealer said.
In north Texas, active nearby trade was noted at $80 a ton, unchanged from the price traded on Tuesday.
"I don't think it (the price) is going to go anywhere, but it has bottomed out," one Texas dealer said.

Buyers, however, were continuing in large part to buy only spot shipments, with many believing prices could fall further in the short term and not expecting a major recovery until pastures start to dry up in July.
